collection.title: KIA Stonic 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A KIA Stonic 2017 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blades for this KIA Stonic, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
